findings.title: New mission readiness attests a search-path alias rather than the required physical public relation
findings.description: All three mission catalog reads bind the bare token managed_mission_revision through to_regclass(:table). No relation namespace/kind/persistence identity is read. Public function namespace does not prove public table identity. A structurally exact relation in a caller-first schema can hide an absent or malformed canonical public table.
concrete_reproducer: On a reviewed disposable fixture in one rollbackable transaction: CREATE SCHEMA review_shadow; ALTER TABLE public.managed_mission_revision SET SCHEMA review_shadow.
CREATE TABLE public.managed_mission_revision (LIKE review_shadow.managed_mission_revision INCLUDING ALL); this public replacement lacks the root FK and both triggers because LIKE does not copy them.
SET LOCAL search_path TO review_shadow,public; call the real schema_reason_on on this same connection.

The existing stamp, other public tables and function namespace are unchanged. Each mission lookup resolves the intact review_shadow table; its root FK still targets visible public.managed_record. findings.title: M2 id CHECK accepts a numeric JSON scalar after UUID text coercion
findings.description: IS TRUE closes NULL but does not preserve the JSON id type: ->> serializes numbers as text, and PostgreSQL uuid accepts 32 hex digits without hyphens. Unlike the root id comparison, the new envelope id check does not compare the JSON value to to_jsonb(mission_id::text).
concrete_reproducer: Use valid canonical M1 id 11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111, a same-owner/run genuine mission root, and an M2 envelope with otherwise-valid kind/schema/revision/predecessor.
Change ONLY the M2 JSON id to numeric scalar 11111111111141118111111111111111 (not a string); recompute the fixture digest independently if retained.

Current (envelope->>'id')::uuid equals mission_id. The guard does not inspect NEW.envelope's id type. Require denial and unchanged rows; contrast with the canonical string id positive. PG insert NOT_RUN. Python UUID alias equality and exact current source were inspected, not substituted for PostgreSQL proof.
findings.violated_requirement: Decision line22: NULL/missing/coercions must not pass the new SQL CHECK; mission envelope identity must remain the original UUID, not a different JSON type accepted through coercion.
